description: Header file defining classes and functions for EFI-related GPIO control, including pin initialization, management, and hardware interaction for an engine control system.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Represents a single GPIO output pin with methods for initialization, state control, and status tracking.

classes.name: NamedOutputPin
classes.description: Extends OutputPin with a name property and methods for setting high/low states and stopping the pin.

classes.name: InjectorOutputPin
classes.description: Specialized NamedOutputPin for injector control, including reset and timing properties.

classes.name: IgnitionOutputPin
classes.description: Specialized NamedOutputPin for ignition control, including reset and spark signal properties.

classes.name: EnginePins
classes.description: Container class for managing multiple output pins related to engine control, including relays, LEDs, and injectors.

methods.name: initPin
methods.description: Initializes a GPIO pin with a message, pin identifier, and output mode.

methods.name: unregisterOutput
methods.description: Dissociates a pin from this output and unregisters it.

methods.name: isInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the pin has been initialized.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the logic value of the pin.

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles the current state of the pin.

methods.name: getLogicValue
methods.description: Returns the current logic value of the pin.

methods.name: setHigh
methods.description: Sets the pin to a high state.

methods.name: setLow
methods.description: Sets the pin to a low state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the pin operation, returning true if stopped.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the pin to default state.
